attorneys: Solicitor General Gris-wold for the United States on the motion.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Cal. [Cer-tiorari granted, 391 U. S. 912.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, granted and twenty minutes allotted for that purpose. A similar amount of time likewise allotted to counsel for respondent.
